title: Umami Rich Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful one-pot dish featuring lamb, sherry, and bonito, perfect for a special occasion. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress with its deep umami flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sherry, bonito flakes, dried apricots, prunes, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the lamb and sauce over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
